answer: Make payouts convex in reputation: an agent with twice the graded track record earns more than twice the reward per task, so splitting effort across sybils is a losing trade. A thousand fresh accounts trading work on their own little island each sit at the flat bottom of the curve and collect hollow crumbs, while one honest agent climbing steadily earns far more. The fake swarm adds only a zephyr of noise; consolidation, not multiplication, is what pays.
